model_metadata_verification: Ollama /api/tags returned all five exact installed deployment digests without loading a model or starting inference; every digest must be rechecked at the resource gate.

development_smoke.reason: Both the strict failure and post-hoc semantic result were known before this plan was frozen. Ornith receives one fresh post-freeze attempt under the same rules as every deployment.

order_method: Counterbalance the four distinct earlier five-model designs DBCEA, AEDBC, CABED and EDACB. A fifth order cannot give every alias an unused position because A and D both have only position 4 unused. Maximize the number of aliases receiving a previously unused position, then maximize the minimum absolute displacement from the latest EDACB design, then maximize total displacement and apply a lexicographic tie-break. BCEDA gives B, C, D and E new positions, moves every alias by at least two positions from EDACB and has total displacement 12.

methodology.generation_verification_boundary: Generate with deferred verification when local Ollama access requires elevation; execute candidate code only in the later workspace-sandbox command.

evaluation.primary_contract: The unmodified source response must satisfy the whole-file envelope and all deterministic checks.
evaluation.secondary_applicability: Only strict malformed_artifact responses that satisfy the frozen fence-only extraction protocol. Empty outputs, ambiguous mappings, prose-bearing responses and arbitrary repair are ineligible.
evaluation.valid_strict_artifact_semantics: Use the primary verifier result directly; transport normalization is not applicable.
evaluation.cross_case_aggregation: Keep strict delivery success and code-semantic diagnostics separate at task level. Do not create a universal composite coding score.

performance_interpretation: Wall time and Ollama timing fields are exploratory cold-attempt diagnostics. One attempt per model does not estimate steady-state latency, latency tails or reliability distributions.

execution_authorization.authorization_scope: Freeze this plan and execute it in one continuous workflow after tests, commit and a passing resource gate; no additional confirmation is required.

interpretation_limit: This is one PHP development task and one post-freeze attempt per deployment. It can compare strict automated delivery and verifier-confirmed semantics on this case but cannot establish general PHP superiority, reliability, stochasticity or a least-cost sufficient configuration.
